name: Keyring (Harvard Applied Technology Lab)
purpose: Phone wallet for your own identity, your relationships and the communities you belong to.

stack.credentials: DTG credentials (W3C VC 2.0, eddsa-jcs-2022 and eddsa-rdfc-2022): VRC, witness and vetting statements, VMC, VAC, VIC; pre-core Witness/Endorsement types too
stack.transport: DIDComm v1/v2 between wallets; TSP (Rev 3 / 1.0) on the VTI peer leg
stack.trustTasks: @openvtc/trust-tasks ^0.27.8; about 100 registry types (vtc, vta, vetting, acl, auth, vault, credential-exchange, witness, vrc)
stack.groups: joins VTI communities; no group model of its own documented
stack.devices: one wallet per device; did:peer and did:key on the device, did:webvh personas via a VTA

credentials.note: Both the DTG Core statement form and the pre-core Witness/Endorsement types appear in the code; VC 1.1 contexts appear too.

messaging.note: Peer leg to the agent (VTA); TSP Rev 3 also in the code.
Wallet to wallet; DIDComm v1 also in the code.

replication.viaName: VTC host, through the person's agent
replication.note: Community rooms: read, post, accept offers.

trustTaskUse.note: @openvtc/trust-tasks ^0.27.8 in keyring-bifold; older 0.6 to 0.9 pins in the tsp-reference stages of keyring-wallet.

requiredParty: a VTA and mediator for the VTI leg; wallet-to-wallet over DIDComm

did-resolution.note: did:peer and did:key on device; did:webvh via VTA.

vrc-exchange.note: DTG VRC exchange wallet to wallet; acceptance of foreign issuers to be checked.

same-carrier.note: TSP only on the VTI peer leg; VRC path over DIDComm.

document-framework.note: Trust Tasks 0.9.0 on the DIDComm path.

membership-statement.note: Holds VMCs and vetting credentials issued by VTI communities; shown with OpenVTC in Prague, October 2026.

error-answers.note: @openvtc/trust-tasks includes trust-task-error; whether the wallet shows it is not documented.

direct-message.note: DIDComm v2 between wallets through mediators; whether a person-to-person message is a Trust Task document is not documented.

registry-lookup.note: Joins communities through a VTA, which reads the VTC trust registry.

newcomer-history.note: MLS data rooms via the VTA; what a newcomer may read follows the host's epoch chain.

captured-device.note: MLS data rooms via the VTA; removing a leaf rotates the epoch (MLS PCS). Not stated as a cross-app property.
